spec: DATA_MODEL.md §18 module 12 — users 7, user_credentials (a password each), rooms 2, room_members, messages 6.
note: Rooms, members and messages live in this file rather than in entitlements.json because they are facts about people; entitlements.json holds policy (grants, quotas, the surveillance lexicon). §18 names three fixtures for module 12 and does not say which of the three carries the messaging rows, so seed/users.ts documents this split as the one it reads.
passwordNote: DEV ONLY. Every seeded account shares the password API.md L1400 uses in its login example. It is hashed with pgcrypto `crypt(password, gen_salt('bf', 12))`, which draws a random salt and is therefore NOT deterministic — so seed/users.ts inserts a credential only when the user has no live password row (ON CONFLICT … DO NOTHING on `user_credentials_password_uniq`) rather than the DO UPDATE that http/auth/password.ts#setPassword performs. A re-seed must not rotate a password, and a bcrypt hash must not be the one value that makes the idempotence acceptance row fail (DATA_MODEL §18).
webauthnNote: No `webauthn` credential is seeded: §18 says WebAuthn is registered at first login, and a public key we minted would be a credential nobody holds the private half of. `mfa_required` is false on every row so the e2e specs can reach a screen.
verificationNote: `person_verified_at` and `sanctions_screened_at` are set (SEC-01 onboarding evidence, REG-06 screening) with `verified_by` absent: the attestation is manual in v1 and there is no system actor at seed time. A user id pointing at whichever seeded account happened to run the seed would be evidence of nothing.
roomsNote: No message carries an MSG-04 attachment. `messages` is WORM and hash-chained (0013, 0017.f): a row cannot be amended, so an attachment that resolves to an instrument id only after seed/universe has landed would be either permanently missing or a seventh message written by a later run — and the second of those breaks the §18 idempotence contract this package's acceptance test asserts. MSG-04 attachment rendering is covered by MSG.test.ts, which seeds its own room.

messages.body: morning — flagging the print on the open
seen it. holding the position, will revisit after the close
ok — sending the desk the same note
desk copy of the open note is on the board
acknowledged — my screens are on the official close, so I will reconcile tomorrow
research follow-up lands before the bell

readsNote: pm has read the dm to seq 2 and nothing in the firm room, so MSG shows one unread in the dm and three in the firm room — a seeded desk with a non-zero unread count, because a screen whose every counter is zero cannot show that the counter works.
